question: Which of the following is NOT an agro-based industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fertilizer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fertilizer** is NOT an agro-based industry.
 
• Agro-based industries use agricultural products as raw materials.
 
• Examples of agro-based industries include **sugar, edible oil, and jute**.
 
• **The sugar** industry uses sugarcane, the **edible oil** industry uses seeds like soybean and sunflower, and **jute** industry uses jute fibres as raw materials.
 
• On the other hand, the **fertilizer** industry primarily involves the production of fertilizers, which are chemical compounds used to enhance plant growth and soil fertility.
